info.name: Clio API Documentation Activities Conversations API
Return the data for all Conversations

params.name: contact_id
params.description: Filter Conversation records for the contact.

params.name: created_since
params.description: Filter Conversation records to those having the `created_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).

params.name: date
params.description: Filter Conversation records created on a given date. (Expects an ISO-8601 date).

params.name: fields
params.description: The fields to be returned. See response samples for what fields are available. For more information see the [fields section](#section/Fields).

params.name: for_user
params.description:
If set to true, filter Conversation records accessible to any groups of the user.
Note that the user may not be member of the conversations.

If set to false, filter Conversation records of which the user is a member.

params.name: ids[]
params.description: Filter Conversation records to those having the specified unique identifiers.

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of Conversation records to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 200. Default: `200`.

params.name: matter_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single Matter. Use the keyword `null` to match those without a Conversation. The list will be filtered to include only the Conversation records with the matching property.

params.name: order
params.description: Orders the Conversation records by the given field. Default: `id(asc)`.

params.name: page_token
params.description: A token specifying which page to return.

params.name: read_status
params.description: Filter Conversation records to those which have been read.

params.name: time_entries
params.description: Filter Conversation records to those with or without associated time entries.

params.name: updated_since
params.description: Filter Conversation records to those having the `updated_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).
